messages:
sara: Heads up — staging perf suite flagged a regression after the galen-3b-v4 onboarding merge. p99 token-gen latency ~2.1x for sequences >1024. CI perf job failed. Bisect points at a tokenizer config bump plus kernel-selector choosing a slower path.
ci-bot: perf/staging/p99 — FAILED — build r-7843 — p99 420ms -> 920ms — logs: https://ci.internal/builds/r-7843/artifacts/perf.txt
rahul: did we change tokenizer normalization or default max_length in the model config?
jamie: I pulled the failing shard and ran a quick profile — flamegraph attached (https://profiler.internal/fg/231456). Kernel_picker is preferring aten_attention for long seqs because the seq_len histogram shifted (more tokens in prefix). Also seeing KV cache evict_count spike.
maria: is this isolated to coralv2 nodes or seen across hosts?
jamie: reproduces on coralv2 and coralv3. The new tokenizer mapping emits an extra prefix token in ~3% of inputs, pushing many traces over the 1024 threshold which routes to the aten path. kv evict_count per req went 8 -> 35 in the repro.
sara: can we pin the tokenizer mapping back to the previous commit while we investigate? That seems fastest to restore perf.
rahul: short mitigation: I can add a per-model override to force kernel_picker heuristic to prefer the fast fused attention for galen-3b-v4. Drafting a patch now, but we should stop the staging->prod rollout until we confirm.
infra-bot: rollout:galen-3b-v4 — STOPPED by sara — reason: perf regression — ticket: INC-6742 — action: hold canary and prod promotions
jamie: repro command I used:
```
python tools/run_perf.py --model galen-3b-v4 --batch 1 --seq 1536 --profile
```
Log excerpt:
```
[kernel_picker] chose aten_attention (expected fused_fast) — measured latency x2.4
[kv_cache] evict_count=35, avg_kv_insert_latency=12ms
```
maria: can we run an A/B on a dedicated pool: tokenizer v3 (old) vs v4 (new) to confirm kernel selection delta?
rahul: yes — I'll trigger canary A/B on dedicated-pool-3 and collect kernel_choice histograms + kv metrics. ETA ~30m. If old mapping wins, we revert mapping and open a follow-up to fix kernel heuristics.
jamie: long-term: need kernel_picker to consult a per-model seq_len histogram and sampled prefix lengths before picking kernels, plus a safety override for KV eviction spike detection. Filed PR #4129 to add sampling + fallback thresholds.
sara: thanks all — keep updates here. tagging @oncall and @release to enforce monitoring and hold.
